title: Central Bank of Denver, N.A. v. First Interstate Bank of Denver, N.A.
passages: Because the text of section 10(b) does not itself reach those who aid and abet a violation, a private plaintiff may not maintain an aiding and abetting suit under section 10(b).
The statute prohibits only the making of a material misstatement or omission or the commission of a manipulative act.

title: Chiarella v. United States
passages: A duty to disclose under section 10(b) does not arise from the mere possession of nonpublic market information.
When an allegation of fraud is based upon nondisclosure, there can be no fraud absent a duty to speak.

title: Ernst & Ernst v. Hochfelder
passages: Section 10(b) and Rule 10b-5 require a showing of scienter, that is, an intent to deceive, manipulate, or defraud.
The words manipulative or deceptive used in conjunction with device or contrivance strongly suggest that section 10(b) was intended to proscribe knowing or intentional misconduct.

title: Securities Exchange Act of 1934
passages: It shall be unlawful for any person to use or employ, in connection with the purchase or sale of any security, any manipulative or deceptive device or contrivance in contravention of such rules and regulations as the Commission may prescribe.

title: Employment of manipulative and deceptive devices
passages: It shall be unlawful to make any untrue statement of a material fact or to omit to state a material fact necessary in order to make the statements made not misleading.
It shall be unlawful to engage in any act, practice, or course of business which operates as a fraud or deceit upon any person, in connection with the purchase or sale of any security.

title: Basel III: A global regulatory framework for more resilient banks and banking systems
passages: Basel III raised the minimum common equity tier 1 capital requirement to 4.5 percent of risk-weighted assets and introduced a capital conservation buffer of 2.5 percent.
The framework introduced a non-risk-based leverage ratio to constrain excess leverage in the banking sector and to serve as a backstop to the risk-based capital requirements.
